course_outline_concepts: Repo tour: huggingface/trl — stable vs experimental folder split
PPO / GRPO / online-DPO trainers as they actually exist in the experimental folder
Accelerate-based single-process orchestration — what breaks at scale
HF ecosystem integrations (peft, datasets, transformers) and their eval-time implications
When TRL is the right choice and when you've outgrown it

sources.what_to_extract: trl/experimental/ppo/ppo_trainer.py inner-loop (~L820-870) and metric block (~L883-907); AutoModelForCausalLMWithValueHead co-location; K1 vs K2 KL; symmetric clip; value-clip trick; KL-on-reward not KL-in-loss; deprecation of value-head PPO in favor of GRPO/RLOO.

trl/trainer/grpo_trainer.py ~2700 LOC; _compute_loss (~L2418-2610) monolithic body; loss_type switch (grpo/bnpo/dr_grpo/dapo/cispo/sapo/luspo/vespo); K3 KL inline; top_entropy_quantile masking; vLLM IS correction toggle; advantage unsqueeze broadcast.

trl/experimental/online_dpo/online_dpo_trainer.py training_step (~L1186-1230); two-sample-per-prompt pattern; _generate_vllm vs _generate_vllm_colocate (~L585-893); Judge plugin interface; missing_eos_penalty; sigmoid vs ipo loss_type; on-policy rollout refresh.

Zephyr-7B reference recipe: SFTConfig(packing=True, train_on_response_only=True, max_seq_length=2048); DPOConfig(beta=0.1); YAML per stage (sft/, dpo/, orpo/, kto/); FSDP FULL_SHARD vs ZeRO-3 crossover; UltraChat-200K + UltraFeedback-Binarized; MT-Bench + AlpacaEval + IFEval eval.
DPOTrainer.loss_type parameter exposes sigmoid/ipo/kto/simpo/orpo/bco/cpo; one trainer, many losses; variant-selection guidance; reference-free successors (SimPO/ORPO) skip π_ref entirely.
The canonical three-stage diagram TRL is built around: SFT → RM → PPO-with-KL; r_total = r(x,y) − β·KL(π||π_ref); why KL regularization matters; what this post predates (DPO, GRPO, RLVR).
GRPO loss Eq. 3 and K3 KL Eq. 4 — the algebra that trl/trainer/grpo_trainer.py implements verbatim.
DPO Eq. 7 closed-form loss; implicit reward r̂ = β·log(π/π_ref); why DPOTrainer needs π_ref loaded but frozen; β=0.1 recipe default.
Clipped surrogate L^CLIP and L^CLIP+VF+S combined objective — the math TRL's experimental PPOTrainer fuses into one file. GAE λ=0.95 default; value-loss coef c1=1.0.

deliverables: figures/trl-stack.html (interactive stack-layer diagram: datasets → tokenizer → SFTTrainer/DPOTrainer/GRPOTrainer → Accelerate → torch; clickable layers expose API + scaling pain point; ~200-280 lines, self-contained, no external CDNs)
hard_rules: No external CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Quote TRL class signatures + config verbatim from raw-data sources
Explain Accelerate single-process limitation with concrete failure modes (Ray gap, stragglers, vLLM handoff)
Include decision gate for outgrowing TRL: throughput / multi-node / custom RL algos / advanced rollout orchestration
Comparison with verl ([[ch-55]]) and OpenRLHF ([[ch-56]]) must reference concrete architectural axes, not vibes
